struck: In the office, a debit card is a $3.95 flat charge.
use: (cut the $3.95 debit figure: the Tax Payer Services page says $3.95, the Real Property Tax page says in-office card payments carry the same fees as online; say paying by card in the office costs a fee, and a credit card is 2.35%)

struck: A bill from a dealer purchase is due on receipt; after 120 days the license or registration is suspended.
use: A bill from a dealer purchase is due when it comes. If it is still unpaid 120 days after the purchase, a final notice gives 30 more days before the license and registration are suspended.

struck: The old tax office on 21st Avenue North is closed.
use: The Treasurer's Myrtle Beach office is now listed at 332 Hinson Drive, in the Central Coast Complex in Carolina Forest.

struck: Write to the Assessor within 90 days of a value notice, or by January 15 of the next year if no notice came.
use: Write to the Assessor within 90 days after a value notice is mailed. In a year with no value notice, you may appeal in writing at any time; one filed by January 15 counts for that year's bill, and a later one counts for the next year.

struck: The County Board of Assessment Appeals has 11 members.
use: (cut the member count: it is only on the county's summary page, which also carries superseded appeal text)

struck: Only attorneys, CPAs and enrolled agents can represent you in the appeal.
use: A lawyer, a CPA, an enrolled agent, or a licensed or certified appraiser on a value question may present the appeal for you, and you may do it yourself. A real estate agent may not.

struck: A $0 on the Residential Exemption line on a home you live in means the 4% is not on.
use: (cut it: no bill or county source ties the Residential Exemption line to the 4% legal residence credit)

pattern: (?:second home|not (?:your|the owner's|their) legal residence|not a legal residence)[^.]{0,140}\b(?:separate|second|another|its own) (?:tax )?(?:bill|notice)\b
struck: A home that is not the owner's legal residence on December 31 gets a separate bill for its furnishings.
use: If a property was not your legal residence on December 31, the Auditor asks for a personal property return (PT-100). Furniture in a rental is taxed on its own notice.
